name: Starlight Carousel of Crystal Birds
description: A vintage carousel where each mount is a crystal bird, wings outstretched, rotating under a canopy of projected constellations.
prompt: An ornate carousel at night. Instead of horses, crystal birds — eagles, owls, hummingbirds — perch on polished brass poles. Overhead, a dome projects moving constellations. Lights sparkle on facets. Warm nostalgic glow, 8K.
caption: Ride a crystal bird through the stars. 🎠✨ #StarlightCarouselCrystalBirds
